from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    base = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    def mode(seq):
        return Counter(seq).most_common(1)[0][0]

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if mode(grid[r]) != base]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if mode([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) != base]

    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [[base]]

    # The line color is the most common value among the sampled intersections.
    vals = [grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in cols]
    line_color = mode(vals)

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            block = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]]
            ]
            counts = Counter(v for v in block if v != line_color)
            winner, count = counts.most_common(1)[0] if counts else (base, 0)
            out_row.append(winner if count >= 3 else base)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out

            if dominant(grid[r])[0] != base and dominant(grid[r])[1] > 0.6]
    cols = [c for c in range(w)
            if dominant([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)])[0] != base
            and dominant([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)])[1] > 0.6]

    out = []

                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            )
            result_row.append(corners[0] if len(set(corners)) == 1 else base)
        out.append(result_row)
